artworks.title: Anna Held
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on cream-colored velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person in profile view, resting their hand against their mouth or chin area. The person has defined facial features, long hair, and is wearing intricately designed clothing. The background consists of rough pencil strokes creating an abstract texture. There are no visible accessories in the sketch.

artworks.title: Yvette Guilbert?
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch showing two individuals. The person on the left is in profile, facing right with her head tilted slightly up. She has refined facial features and styled hair, wearing a patterned garment and a wide-brimmed hat with feathers or lace. To her right, a man wears a dark top hat tilted downward, showing only his chin and mouth. Minimal background details include rough outlines of trees and a small animal, possibly a horse.

artworks.title: Jeanne Hading
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on hand-made paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing an upper body portrait of a person from the shoulders up. The person is drawn in a slightly reclined position looking upwards. The facial features are detailed, with heavily shaded eyes, a small upturned nose, and prominent lips. The hair is styled voluminously, falling around the sides with a large, rounded shape on top. The person is depicted wearing clothing with a high, ruffled collar, ornamental pattern, and puffed shoulders. The background is minimally sketched with light shading to create texture and depth.

artworks.title: Jeanne Hading
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on cream-colored paper
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body sketch of a person, focusing on the head and shoulders. The person is drawn in a slightly upward tilt, with their face turned to the front. The facial features include dark, slightly arched eyebrows, closed eyes, and prominent lips. The hair is styled elaborately, adding volume and texture to the sketch. The person is wearing high-necked clothing with decorative elements. The background consists of light sketch lines. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the image.

artworks.title: Polin
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on cream-colored paper
artworks.description: The image shows the back of a person seated and leaning slightly forward. The person is wearing a hat with a brim, short dark hair is visible, and they have a roundish face in profile. The figure is dressed in a loose-fitting coat and appears to be holding onto or pressing against a surface near their side. In the background are sketched lines and shapes suggesting a busy scene with people, tables, and chairs, possibly set in a street or market environment. Indistinct circular shapes above suggest string lights or decorative elements, creating a lively and crowded impression.

artworks.title: Eva Lavallière
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing the upper half of a person's body. The person appears to be reclining or leaning back slightly. They have distinct facial features with dark eyes, and curly dark hair cascading over their shoulders. They are wearing a large brimmed hat and a garment with a pattern, possibly a polka-dot scarf or collar. The person's hand is raised, with fingers bent, in front of a textured or striped background. The background is shaded with lines, creating a sense of depth behind the figure.

artworks.title: Eva Lavallière
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on cream-colored paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a woman's upper body. She is reclining slightly with her head tilted to the side. The sketch features her bold facial features, including large eyes, defined eyebrows, and slightly open lips. The woman has dark, curly hair cascading over her shoulders. She is adorned with a wide-brimmed hat and a neckerchief tied around her neck. She wears a garment with a high collar and intricate detailing. One of her hands is raised, adding movement to the image. The background has a minimal textured pattern.

artworks.title: Emilienne d'Alençon
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's profile from the chest up. The person's face is turned to the right. The sketch is abstract, with light lines indicating facial features, hair, and clothing. Another figure or figures to the right are suggested, with possible indications of horseback and a setting. The background is loosely sketched with textured lines.

artworks.title: Emilienne d'Alençon
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on cream-colored velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows the side profile of a person facing right, with suggested facial features and voluminous hair. The attire is depicted with flowing lines and hints at layered or ruffled fabric. A figure, potentially a coachman or horse rider, is in the foreground to the right. In the background, there are abstract lines and shading suggesting depth and movement.

artworks.title: Cassive
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on cream-colored velin paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing the upper body of a person in profile from the side. The person is positioned facing to the right with their head turned slightly away from the viewer. The sketch outlines subtle facial features, including a defined nose and lip line and an almond-shaped eye. Their hair appears to be pinned up or tied back simply. The person's clothing is loosely sketched, indicating flowing fabric with gentle lines suggesting the garment's drape. There is no clear depiction of jewelry, and they are not holding any objects. The background is plain, with a small circular shape in the upper left corner of the image, leaving the focus on the figure itself.

artworks.title: Cassive
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on hand-made paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a person in a side profile. The individual is shown from the waist up, facing to the right. The facial features are simplified with just a nose and lips indicated. The hair is loosely drawn, gathered at the back. The clothing is suggested with flowing lines hinting at layers or ruffles. No jewelry or objects are visible. The background is plain with some light marks and speckles.

artworks.title: Lender and Lavalliere in "Le fils de l'Aretin" (Lender et Lavallière dans "Le fils de l'Arétin")
artworks.description: This print shows two people, one made with dark lines, and one made with lighter, sketch-like lines. In the center is a person standing with their arms bent at the elbows, one hand holding a book and the other with a finger pointed upward. This person has a small nose, thin lips, short light-colored hair, and they are wearing a dark puff-sleeved dress with a high neck and textured skirt, along with a dark, flat hat. The person on the left is a ghostly outline, facing the right and looking upwards, with pale skin, faint features, and their hair in an updo. They also appear to wear a dress with a high neck and puffed sleeves. The background is light beige with some faint vertical streaks of light gray shading.

artworks.title: Supper in London (Souper à Londres)
artworks.description: The sketch shows three individuals at a table. The main focus is on a woman on the left and a man on the right. They are seated closely together. The woman has an upturned head with a calm expression, styled hair, and wears an elaborate outfit with floral details on her arms. The man has a clean face, slicked-back hair, and wears a high-collared garment. There is a third figure outlined behind them. A bottle is on the table in the bottom right. The background is subtly shaded with vertical strokes.

artworks.title: Supper in London (Souper à Londres)
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch showing three people, all depicted with their upper bodies only. The main focus is on two figures in the foreground, a man and a woman, seated closely. The woman is facing slightly to the left with her head turned upward. She has distinctive facial features, with a pronounced chin and lips, and her hair is styled in an updo. She is wearing a dress with ruffled details. The man next to her is turned slightly towards her, with delicate facial features and a calm expression. His hair is short, and he is dressed in a suit with a high collar. Both figures seem to be holding glasses, as suggested by their hand positions and what appears to be a bottle on the table in front of them. In the background, there is a lightly sketched third figure, a man standing and facing forward. The background is mostly filled with vertical lines and faint patterns, giving the impression of a textured environment.

artworks.title: Anna Held and Baldy (Anna Held et Baldy)
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman's torso in a side-facing pose, with her face turned slightly to the left. Her facial features are simple, and she has expressive, voluminous hair. She wears what appears to be an off-the-shoulder dress and holds an upright object. To her left is another figure with a helmet or cap, and less defined facial features, possibly a mask. The background is lightly shaded and abstract.

artworks.title: At the Picton Bar, rue Scribe (Au bar Picton, rue Scribe)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The drawing shows three people seated at a bar. The central figure is a woman seen from the back, leaning slightly towards the bar. Her hair is up, and she wears a dress with puffed sleeves and a fitted bodice. She holds a glass at the bar. To her left, a man in profile wears a dark overcoat, top hat, and holds a cigar. To her right, another man with a bowler hat looks towards the woman. The background features a window with partially legible text, suggesting a bar or cafe setting.

artworks.title: Debauchery (Débauche)
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of two figures seated close together. The central figure is a woman with red curly hair and wearing a white dress. She sits with a relaxed posture, gazing away. The man behind her leans close, with short slicked-back hair and one arm around the woman. The background is muted red with text detailing "Catalogue d'Affiches artistiques A. Arnould 7 rue Racine Paris."

artworks.title: Poster for "Elles"
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green, blue, and orange
artworks.description: The image shows a person from behind, revealing their entire body. The person is standing upright with their arms raised, holding their hair up. They have long red hair that they are styling or securing. The individual is wearing a long, dark blue dress with voluminous sleeves and a light-colored, fluffy collar. Around them, there is a sketched outline of a top hat and some bare outlines of furniture or drapery. The background is a light beige, featuring text in red and grayish tones about a lithography exhibition. The top left corner includes a small circular mark, and there is a faint stamp in the central upper region.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "Elles"
artworks.medium: color lithograph on thin wove paper
artworks.description: The image is of a person standing with their back to the viewer, lifting their bright red-orange long hair with both hands. They are wearing a gown that has a deep blue lower half and a pale, ruffled top section in a lighter shade. Around the person are muted beige tones, sketch-like lines, and a top hat resting on a surface to the left. The background shows an abstract design with light brushstrokes and a faded pattern, creating a soft, vintage ambiance.

artworks.title: Soudais Deposition (Déposition Soudais)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures wearing formal attire, engaged in a meeting. The figures are depicted with light pencil strokes on paper, wearing hats and formal garments. Some figures are focused on a document, while others are conversing or listening attentively. The composition emphasizes expressive gestural lines, capturing a moment of concentration and engagement. Background and details are minimally suggested.

artworks.title: Lebaudy Trial - Testimony of Mlle. Marsy (Procès Lebaudy - Déposition de Mlle. Marsy)
artworks.description: This image is a sketch showing the upper body of several figures. The central figure is a woman positioned in profile, slightly turned to the side. Her facial features are delicately sketched, lacking detailed refinement but suggest closed eyes and a serene expression. Her hair is drawn with a textured, voluminous quality, suggesting an upswept style. The woman is wearing a garment with a high collar and loose, flowing lines indicating the presence of clothing, perhaps a cape or coat. A stick or umbrella can be seen clasped in her hand. Surrounding her are faint, roughly sketched figures of people, wearing headgear or hats. The background is minimal, with a light cream color as the base of the sketch.

artworks.title: Program for "La lepreuse"  (Programme pour "La lépreuse")
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in profile view, with their head turned to the side. The individual is seated with hands clasped in front of their chest. The facial features are sketched minimally, and the person has medium-length, wavy hair. The clothing is depicted faintly, suggesting a long-sleeved garment with a structured fit. There are no visible jewelry or objects. In the background, there is text with details about a theatrical show called "Comédie-Parisienne," including the title "La Lépreuse" and a list of cast members. The image is drawn in a sepia tone, resembling pencil or charcoal on paper.

artworks.title: Cover for "La tribu d'Isodore" (Couverture pour "La tribu d'Isodore")
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a horse-drawn carriage. He is holding the reins with his left hand and his right hand is resting on his thigh. The man has a strong jawline, a prominent mustache, and is wearing a bowler hat, a suit, and a bow tie. A small terrier dog is beside him in the carriage. Above him are sketches of the same man with a top hat and of a different person's head and neck. The background is a plain flat surface.

artworks.title: New Year's Greeting (Le compliment du jour de l'an)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a seated figure and a standing figure with accompanying text. The image is done in a light, whimsical style. There are two figures interacting, one seated and one standing, with the standing figure holding an item out. Below them is a small seated figure drawn in a simple style. At the bottom is handwritten French text. The drawing is in pencil or a similar medium, creating a casual and light-hearted atmosphere.
